name: Hearthwarden
lore: A mountain-born guardian whose traveling forge shelters every companion brave enough to stand beside him.

primary.name: Forge Rhythm
primary.description: Two close hammer swings hit for 22 each. A third swing within 1.8s deals 33 in a wider arc and pushes foes back. Waiting resets the combo.

secondary.name: Rally Standard
secondary.description: Plant a banner up to 120 ahead for 5s. You and allies within 130 take 18% less damage. One banner at a time; enemies receive no protection.

special.name: Hold the Line
special.description: Send a 220-wide shield wall forward for 2.4s. It catches up to 6 moving hostile shots and hits each enemy once for 50, briefly stunning, pushing and slowing them. Walls stop its march; beams and lobbed explosions bypass it.

passive: Steadfast Forge: Completing the third hammer swing grants 15% damage reduction for 2s. A golden ward shows the protection.

technique.name: Traveling Standard
technique.description: The banner follows you, but its protection drops to 12% and its radius to 90. Same 5s duration.

final_technique.name: Forgefall
final_technique.description: Replace the advancing shield with three visible falling anvils in a line. After a 1s windup, each small blast deals 32 and stuns for 0.7s. No projectile interception; 17s cooldown.

attack.name: Forgefall
attack.description: Three anvils fall after a 1s warning, 0.2s apart. Each 65-radius impact deals 32 and stuns for 0.7s. Lose the shield wall.
